checks.name: multimedia_speech_version_ready_output

    AND "multimedia_speech_versions"."mime_type" IS NOT NULL AND length("multimedia_speech_versions"."mime_type") > 0
    AND "multimedia_speech_versions"."file_size" IS NOT NULL AND "multimedia_speech_versions"."file_size" > 0
    AND "multimedia_speech_versions"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
  )

checks.name: threed_designs_document_valid

checks.name: threed_farmbot_commands_water_resolution_complete
checks.expression:
(
      ("threed_farmbot_commands"."peripheral_id" IS NULL AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."peripheral_pin" IS NULL AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."duration_ms" IS NULL)

checks.name: threed_farmbot_commands_recovery_lifecycle_valid
checks.expression:
(
      ("threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_state" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_rpc_label" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_error_code" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_required_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_dispatched_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_resolved_at" IS NULL)
      OR
      ("threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_state" = 'required'
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_rpc_label" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_error_code" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_required_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_dispatched_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_resolved_at" IS NULL)
      OR
      ("threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_state" = 'dispatched'
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_rpc_label" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_error_code" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_required_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_resolved_at" IS NULL)
      OR
      ("threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_state" = 'confirmed'
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_rpc_label" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_error_code" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_required_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)
      OR
      ("threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_state" = 'failed'
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_rpc_label" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_error_code" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_required_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)
    )

checks.name: threed_farmbot_commands_recovery_timestamp_order_valid
checks.expression:
(
      ("threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_dispatched_at" IS NULL OR "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_dispatched_at" >= "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_required_at")
      AND
      ("threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_resolved_at" IS NULL OR "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_resolved_at" >= "threed_farmbot_commands"."recovery_dispatched_at")
    )

checks.name: threed_farmbot_emergency_actions_timestamp_order_valid
checks.expression:
(
      ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."validated_at" IS NULL OR "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."validated_at" >= "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."requested_at")
      AND ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."accepted_at" IS NULL OR "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."accepted_at" >= "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."validated_at")
      AND ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."dispatched_at" IS NULL OR "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."dispatched_at" >= "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."accepted_at")
      AND ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL OR "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."acknowledged_at" >= "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."dispatched_at")
      AND ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" IS NULL OR "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" >= "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."requested_at")
      AND ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" IS NULL OR "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."validated_at" IS NULL
        OR "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" >= "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."validated_at")
      AND ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" IS NULL OR "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."accepted_at" IS NULL
        OR "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" >= "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."accepted_at")
      AND ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" IS NULL OR "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."dispatched_at" IS NULL
        OR "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" >= "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."dispatched_at")
      AND ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" IS NULL OR "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL
        OR "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" >= "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."acknowledged_at")
    )

checks.name: threed_farmbot_emergency_actions_lifecycle_valid
checks.expression:
(
      ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."state" = 'requested' AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."validated_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."dispatched_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."outcome_error_code" IS NULL)
      OR ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."state" = 'validated' AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."peripheral_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."validated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."accepted_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."dispatched_at" IS NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" IS NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."outcome_error_code" IS NULL)
      OR ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."state" = 'accepted' AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."peripheral_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."validated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."dispatched_at" IS NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" IS NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."outcome_error_code" IS NULL)
      OR ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."state" = 'dispatched' AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."peripheral_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."validated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" IS NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."outcome_error_code" IS NULL)
      OR ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."state" = 'acknowledged' AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."peripheral_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."validated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."acknowledged_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."outcome_error_code" IS NULL)
      OR ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."state" = 'failed' AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."peripheral_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."validated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."dispatched_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."outcome_error_code" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."state" = 'rejected' AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."accepted_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."dispatched_at" IS NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."outcome_error_code" IS NOT NULL)
      OR ("threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."state" = 'expired' AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."accepted_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."dispatched_at" IS NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL
        AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL AND "threed_farmbot_emergency_actions"."outcome_error_code" IS NULL)
    )

tables.name: threed_multimedia_albums

checks.name: threed_multimedia_albums_entity
checks.expression:
CASE
    WHEN "threed_multimedia_albums"."module_type" = 'assembly' THEN "threed_multimedia_albums"."entity_id" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    WHEN "threed_multimedia_albums"."entity_id" ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,9}$' THEN "threed_multimedia_albums"."entity_id"::bigint <= 2147483647
    ELSE false END

notes: Original SQL application was Developer-confirmed. Source now uses text entity IDs for numeric and Assembly UUID identities; the follow-up identity SQL is prepared, not confirmed applied. The disputed Learn mapping has been removed from current application paths.

notes: Current working-tree Drizzle declarations, including unreleased changes. This is not a live database inventory or a proposal for a new architecture.
Exactly four Top Modules: ThreeD, Multimedia, Traffic and Learn. Projects, Accounts and Settings are shared foundations.

Solid arrows are declared database foreign keys, from referencing table to referenced table. Optional dashed links represent reviewed application mappings; ORM declarations are a separate optional layer.
All declared tables, columns, enums, indexes, checks, primary and unique keys are included. JSON/JSONB columns remain opaque; this is not an inventory of every nested runtime object.
Application links are the reviewed Project Assets, saved-marker and Album registries, not an exhaustive inference from every ID-shaped column. ORM declarations do not guarantee a valid inferred join.

The unaccepted Learn-to-Guide Album path is absent from current registries. Assembly UUID support is pending application of the prepared identity SQL; the diagram does not certify live migration state.
